title: When Do Foundation Models Pay Off? A Break-Even Analysis of Pretrained Time Series Forecasters
abstract: arXiv:2607.04919v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deploying a time series foundation model (FM) requires GPU infrastructure and engineering overhead, with no guarantee of improvement over classical forecasting methods. We provide the first systematic break-even analysis of when this investment pays off. Across 30 benchmark datasets, we compare zero-shot and LoRA fine-tuned FMs (Chronos-Bolt, Moirai, Lag-Llama) against classical baselines (Naive, ETS, ARIMA, XGBoost) at six training set sizes from 2% to 100% of available data. FMs outperform classical methods at every evaluated training fraction on 16 of 30 datasets. On 6 datasets, classical methods surpass zero-shot FMs with at most 5% of the training data (21--6,324 samples); on the remaining 8, break-even ranges from 24 to 22,177 samples. translated_title: 基础模型何时物有所值？预训练时间序列预测器的盈亏平衡分析
translated_abstract: 部署时间序列基础模型（FM）需要GPU基础设施和额外的工程开销，且并不能保证比经典预测方法有所改进。我们首次对这种投资何时能够回本进行了系统性的盈亏平衡分析。我们在30个基准数据集上，比较了零样本和LoRA微调的基础模型（Chronos-Bolt、Moirai、Lag-Llama）与经典基线方法（Naive、ETS、ARIMA、XGBoost）的表现，训练集规模从可用数据的2%到100%共设六个档位。在30个数据集中，有16个数据集上基础模型在所有评估的训练数据比例下均优于经典方法。在6个数据集上，经典方法在训练数据不超过5%（21—6,324个样本）时就能超越零样本基础模型；在其余8个数据集上，盈亏平衡点介于24到22,177个样本之间。没有任何一种经典方法全面占优：ARIMA、Naive、ETS和XGBoost各自在6—11个数据集上表现最佳。我们总结出一条无需模型训练的稳健经验法则：如果训练样本数少于700且季节性不可忽略，零样本基础模型即可……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次系统性地分析了部署时间序列基础模型何时能比经典方法更划算，通过30个数据集的对比实验给出了基于训练样本量和季节性强度的盈亏平衡经验法则（例如训练样本少于700且季节性显著时零样本基础模型即够用）。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic break-even analysis of when time series foundation models pay off over classical forecasting methods, deriving a simple rule (e.g., zero-shot FMs suffice when training samples are below 700 and seasonality is non-negligible) based on benchmarks across 30 datasets.
